title: VASP static calculation
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-static workflow: it performs a single-point total-energy evaluation of a fixed structure with VASP.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure to evaluate.
Output role total_energy is a records entry containing the total energy of the structure.
Output role cartesian_site_forces is a records entry containing the forces on every site of the staged structure, in its site order; it is produced only when the calculation kept the staged geometry.

outputs.name: total_energy
outputs.description: The total energy of the structure.

outputs.name: cartesian_site_forces
outputs.description: The forces on every site of the staged structure, in POSCAR site order, in eV/Å; only when the calculation kept the staged geometry (one ionic configuration, no rattle remedy).
